title: state.json
description: Persistent watcher state machine. Additive fields are allowed (schema stays 2, readers ignore what they do not know); changing or removing a field is a breaking change and needs schema 3. Read through Read-MgState, which falls back to defaults on a torn or foreign file - that is what puts a running game into SAFE MODE instead of a trusted session.

schema.description: State format version. Readers accept only 2; anything else is treated as untrusted.

phase.description: Idle = no session; InGame = we track a session (takeover checks the PID); UnknownSession = the game was already running when the watcher started, so nothing is applied and nothing is adopted.

gamePid.description: PID the session belongs to. A new session is declared only when THIS pid is gone.

gamePath.description: Full path of the game exe at launch: the PID-reuse guard in takeover.

sessionStart.description: UTC ISO-8601 start of the session. Compared only after ConvertTo-UtcTime.

lastApplyUtc.description: UTC mtime of settings.xml right after OUR last write. 'Changed after us' means mtime > lastApplyUtc + 2 s, both in UTC.

applied.description: Did WE successfully apply the golden in this session? Adopt is refused when false.

guardRollbacks.description: Foreign overwrites rolled back in this session.

restarts.description: Self-restart budget used in the last 30 minutes.
